follow-up time: From pregnancy diagnosis until delivery (between April 2020 and October 2022)
cohort: 459 pregnant women who delivered at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Koru Health Groups, Ankara, Cankaya, Turkey, between April 2020 and October 2022.
finding: COVID-19-positive pregnant women had a significantly higher risk of developing oligohydramnios compared to COVID-19-negative pregnant women.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
